publication issues.summary: Team1 visual supplement: native tile 2-4 prints AE6 while routed source remains AA6; no route identity change inferred. Sampled cells show V4 blank switch interiors where source/native show SW, asterisk, 1687MC, PB and portions of identifiers: missing rendered content, not just alignment. Remaining 377-cell findings and unreviewed routes/points remain open. Helper sampled route panels 000–007 without definite edit. Browser model-rendered text differs from installed TXT: 10 positional cells (10 content, 0 whitespace/absence) across 2 lines. Installed TXT SHA256 195cbb864b5a152b09621b71589b55852c2c489eea29af0970aa17df6b0be571; cached render SHA256 01e50555a997bccc06d20f18c733a276c04b27b0ea8a144897518cf5364e79c7. This comparison does not establish electrical correctness. Reported 377 unresolved render cells, 0 wiring glyph differences, 55 uncertainties. Interim packet; individual native discrepancies, continuous routing, junction/crossing ownership, registration, omission and schema/electrical review remain unestablished. Team1’s sealed review also records an output identifier conflict at outputs/PK041AA6: printed AE6 versus routed source AA6. C, NC, NO and BUS switch/contact physical pin identities remain unconfirmed. Human-approved note-group origin normalization does not certify the exact original placement. Sixteen native tiles, 72 route panels and 88 point panels were generated, but full native review and continuous tracing were not completed; external schema validation was not run.
publication issues.qualification: Published for access with the recorded review limitations; no electrical correctness or user approval asserted.
